title: Review of c40's CIPS local-cut finding on fresh seed 7: the cut body shrinks to 46% of its area within ~200 t and survives while its fed twin and the outside bodies are unchanged; here the starved remnant also splits in two and both pieces drift out of the cut disk toward fuel; Supported
summary: I ran the finding's world.py with labkit on seed 7 (t=12000: 16 bodies, 8 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges) and the finding's cut.py on seed 7 (controls/: cut at t=12000, 1500 t after, disk radius 29 px around the most isolated body). Fed twin: target 261 -> 264 px, fuel in the disk 0.77, 16 bodies outside. Cut arm: fuel in the disk falls to 0.55-0.61; the target falls from 261 px to 145 px by +75 t and 118-122 px by +225-450 t (46%), then partly regrows (to 173 px at +1125 t), as on the finding's seed 0. Unlike the finding's seeds, the starved body splits into two small round remnants that move toward the disk edge, where fuel diffuses in, and leave the disk by t~13200-13275 (controls/cut_s7.png: bodies outside the disk 16 -> 18 in the cut arm only). So the size of a body follows its own local fuel, and a local cut does not kill it, as the finding says; the remnants escape the cut region rather than staying as one starved body.

observations.E: controls/cut_s7.json: target 261 -> 118-122 px (+225-450 t) with the local cut vs 260-264 px in the fed twin; controls/cut_s7.png row 2: the target splits into two remnants that drift out of the disk; bodies outside unchanged in the fed twin (16)

seeds_run.result: pass: shrink to 46% within ~225 t, survival; new: remnant splits and both pieces leave the cut disk by +1200-1275 t

controls_run.E: controls/cut_s7.json, controls/cut_s7.png (fed twin vs local cut from the same state at t=12000, seed 7); labkit re-run rerun/seed7

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The cut-arm count of bodies outside the disk rises from 16 to 18 because the target's two remnants cross the disk edge, so it is not an independent measure of the outside bodies there. Fuel diffuses into the disk, so the cut is partial (fuel 0.55-0.61 vs 0.77); a body-local cut never reaches zero supply in this world.
